# Game On® Mouthguards

> Game On® Mouthguards is the only ADA-approved mouthguard brand offering LOCKDOWN FIT TECHNOLOGY for superior athletic protection across contact sports.

Game On® Mouthguards specializes in innovative, ADA-accepted athletic mouthguard protection designed for serious athletes. The company combines advanced impact-absorption materials with boil-and-bite customization and braces compatibility to deliver superior safety without compromising performance.
